title: Why Your AI Answers Are Bland (4-Part Prompt Fix)
topic: prompt formula role task format example
description: Most AI answers are generic because the prompt is. Use the 4-part formula: role, task, format, example. Demo recorded in an incognito Claude chat with made-up details.

parts.text: Your AI answers are bland for one reason. Here's the fix.
Most people type something like: write an email to my boss saying I'll be late. And you get a template full of blanks.
parts.label: VAGUE PROMPT

parts.text: Use the four part formula: role, task, format, and an example.
Same email. Tell it who it is, what happened, how long, the format you want, and the tone.
parts.label: 4-PART PROMPT

parts.text: Now it's ready to send: a clear subject, the real reason, and a friendly tone.
parts.label: RESULT

parts.text: Save this formula, and follow Prompt Minute for one AI trick a day.
